payload.reason: The evidence provides details on how clusters were extracted and their role in feature extraction for various NLP tasks.

claims.text: Clusters were extracted by using text embeddings as a proxy to create features, which involved clustering these embeddings to impact performance in NLP tasks.
The feature extraction process included using cluster membership features, which were shown to improve performance in tasks like Named-Entity recognition and sentiment classification.
The selection of word vectors and the number of clusters was described as a trial-and-error procedure, indicating a systematic approach to determining effective clusters.
